import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
import numpy as np
from datetime import datetime

# Create the dataset
data = {
    'date': ['2024-01-01', '2024-01-01', '2024-01-01', '2024-01-01', '2024-01-01'],
    'time': ['00:00', '02:00', '04:00', '06:00', '08:00'],
    'product': ['Cappuccino', 'Cappuccino', 'Tea', 'Latte', 'Americano'],
    'size': ['Large', 'Medium', 'Small', 'Large', 'Medium'],
    'price': [4.18, 4.01, 5.22, 6.37, 7.07],
    'quantity': [2, 3, 1, 2, 3],
    'payment_method': ['Credit Card', 'Credit Card', 'Credit Card', 'Credit Card', 'Cash'],
    'customer_age_group': ['55+', '35-44', '18-24', '45-54', '45-54'],
    'is_takeaway': [1, 1, 1, 1, 1],
    'total': [8.36, 12.03, 5.22, 12.74, 21.21]
}

df = pd.DataFrame(data)

# Create datetime column for time series analysis
df['datetime'] = pd.to_datetime(df['date'] + ' ' + df['time'])

# Set style
plt.style.use('seaborn-v0_8-darkgrid')
sns.set_palette("husl")

# Create figure with subplots
fig = plt.figure(figsize=(16, 12))

# 1. Sales by Product (Bar chart)
ax1 = plt.subplot(3, 3, 1)
product_sales = df.groupby('product')['total'].sum().sort_values(ascending=False)
bars = ax1.bar(product_sales.index, product_sales.values)
ax1.set_title('Total Sales by Product', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax1.set_ylabel('Total Sales ($)')
ax1.tick_params(axis='x', rotation=45)
for bar in bars:
    height = bar.get_height()
    ax1.text(bar.get_x() + bar.get_width()/2., height + 0.5,
             f'${height:.2f}', ha='center', va='bottom', fontsize=9)

# 2. Sales by Size (Pie chart)
ax2 = plt.subplot(3, 3, 2)
size_sales = df.groupby('size')['total'].sum()
wedges, texts, autotexts = ax2.pie(size_sales.values, labels=size_sales.index, autopct='%1.1f%%',
                                   startangle=90, colors=sns.color_palette("pastel"))
ax2.set_title('Sales Distribution by Size', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
for autotext in autotexts:
    autotext.set_color('black')
    autotext.set_fontsize(10)

# 3. Sales by Age Group (Bar chart)
ax3 = plt.subplot(3, 3, 3)
age_sales = df.groupby('customer_age_group')['total'].sum().sort_values(ascending=False)
bars = ax3.bar(age_sales.index, age_sales.values)
ax3.set_title('Sales by Customer Age Group', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax3.set_ylabel('Total Sales ($)')
ax3.tick_params(axis='x', rotation=45)
for bar in bars:
    height = bar.get_height()
    ax3.text(bar.get_x() + bar.get_width()/2., height + 0.5,
             f'${height:.2f}', ha='center', va='bottom', fontsize=9)

# 4. Sales Trend Over Time (Line chart)
ax4 = plt.subplot(3, 3, 4)
df_sorted = df.sort_values('datetime')
ax4.plot(df_sorted['datetime'], df_sorted['total'], marker='o', linewidth=2, markersize=8)
ax4.set_title('Sales Trend Throughout the Day', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax4.set_xlabel('Time')
ax4.set_ylabel('Total Sale ($)')
ax4.tick_params(axis='x', rotation=45)
for i, (date, total) in enumerate(zip(df_sorted['datetime'], df_sorted['total'])):
    ax4.annotate(f'${total:.2f}', (date, total), textcoords="offset points",
                 xytext=(0,10), ha='center', fontsize=9)

# 5. Payment Method Distribution (Bar chart)
ax5 = plt.subplot(3, 3, 5)
payment_counts = df['payment_method'].value_counts()
bars = ax5.bar(payment_counts.index, payment_counts.values)
ax5.set_title('Payment Method Distribution', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax5.set_ylabel('Number of Transactions')
for bar in bars:
    height = bar.get_height()
    ax5.text(bar.get_x() + bar.get_width()/2., height + 0.1,
             str(int(height)), ha='center', va='bottom', fontsize=10)

# 6. Quantity vs Price Scatter Plot
ax6 = plt.subplot(3, 3, 6)
scatter = ax6.scatter(df['quantity'], df['price'], c=df['total'], s=df['total']*20,
                      alpha=0.6, cmap='viridis')
ax6.set_title('Quantity vs Price (Size = Total Sale)', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax6.set_xlabel('Quantity')
ax6.set_ylabel('Price ($)')
cbar = plt.colorbar(scatter, ax=ax6)
cbar.set_label('Total Sale ($)')

# 7. Average Price by Product and Size (Heatmap)
ax7 = plt.subplot(3, 3, 7)
price_pivot = df.pivot_table(values='price', index='product', columns='size', aggfunc='mean')
sns.heatmap(price_pivot, annot=True, fmt='.2f', cmap='YlOrRd', cbar_kws={'label': 'Average Price ($)'}, ax=ax7)
ax7.set_title('Average Price by Product and Size', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax7.set_xlabel('Size')
ax7.set_ylabel('Product')

# 8. Total Sales by Product and Size (Stacked Bar)
ax8 = plt.subplot(3, 3, 8)
sales_pivot = df.pivot_table(values='total', index='product', columns='size', aggfunc='sum', fill_value=0)
sales_pivot.plot(kind='bar', stacked=True, ax=ax8)
ax8.set_title('Total Sales by Product and Size', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax8.set_ylabel('Total Sales ($)')
ax8.legend(title='Size', bbox_to_anchor=(1.05, 1), loc='upper left')
ax8.tick_params(axis='x', rotation=45)

# 9. Summary Statistics
ax9 = plt.subplot(3, 3, 9)
ax9.axis('off')
summary_text = f"""
Dataset Summary:
Total Transactions: {len(df)}
Total Revenue: ${df['total'].sum():.2f}
Average Transaction: ${df['total'].mean():.2f}
Max Transaction: ${df['total'].max():.2f}
Min Transaction: ${df['total'].min():.2f}
Unique Products: {df['product'].nunique()}
Takeaway Orders: {df['is_takeaway'].sum()}/{len(df)}
"""
ax9.text(0.1, 0.5, summary_text, fontsize=11, verticalalignment='center',
         bbox=dict(boxstyle='round', facecolor='wheat', alpha=0.5))

plt.suptitle('Coffee Shop Sales Analysis - January 1, 2024', fontsize=16, fontweight='bold', y=0.98)
plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('output.png', dpi=300, bbox_inches='tight')
plt.close()
